description: Suggest up to ten long breaks in 2026 or 2027, best first, where a few leave days bridge weekends and Latvian holidays. Use it to decide when to take leave; for the holiday dates alone use latvia_holidays, and for how much leave the user has use latvia_leave_entitlement. pto_days caps the working days of leave each break may use on its own; it is not a yearly budget to split. A break takes every working day between runs of days off and holds a holiday or other day off on a weekday, so a week that only joins two weekends is not listed. Leave is never planned before today in Latvia or before employment_start_date. extra_days_off adds days the employer gives, so breaks can build on them. Breaks rank by days off, then fewer leave days, then date; efficiency is days off per leave day.

employment_start_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD; no leave is planned before it (nor before today in Latvia)

extra_days_off.description: extra days off such as ones the employer gives, YYYY-MM-DD in 2026 or 2027, at most 100

pto_days.description: most working days of leave one break may use, 1 to 100

year.description: year to plan leave in: 2026 or 2027

name: latvia_plan_time_off
